summary.text: J.A. Moore is a Democratic member of the South Carolina House of Representatives who represents District 15, having assumed office on November 12, 2018, and is seeking re-election in the general election on November 3, 2026.
Ballotpedia lists his profession as a chef and food-service manager, and notes that the Democratic primary for his seat was canceled.

paragraphs.text: Moore graduated from Johnson & Wales University with a degree in culinary arts.
His professional experience, according to Ballotpedia, includes working as a chef, restaurant general manager, cafe manager, food and beverage manager, and catering director.
Moore is assigned to the Medical, Military, Public and Municipal Affairs Committee in the 2025-2026 session.
He served as first vice chair of the Interstate Cooperation Committee in the 2023-2024 session and earlier sat on the Agriculture, Natural Resources and Environmental Affairs Committee.
Ballotpedia lists Heather Hickman, a Republican, and Melissa Couture, a Libertarian, as his general-election opponents.
